task.description: Independently verify BACKEND-DEV's fix for GH #520 / ISS-0186 (flaky TC-EXP-301-05 in tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig). Fix replaces a two-round-trip wall-clock delta measurement with a single combined read (next_attempt_at and NOW() in one query, inside the same already-open transaction), tightening tolerance to +/-1.0ms. BACKEND-DEV already ran zig build test-integration once: TC-EXP-301-05 did not appear among failures; confirm this independently, run at least 2-3 times to build confidence the original flake (under concurrent load) is genuinely gone, not just absent by luck on one run.
acceptance_criteria: TC-EXP-301-05 passes in every run, at least 2-3 zig build test-integration runs
No new failures introduced beyond the pre-existing unrelated ones already documented by BACKEND-DEV
DB state clean (no non-idle backends, no stray advisory locks) after each run
